extension.description: Render ```plantuml code blocks in the built-in Markdown preview. No Java, no server, no network connection — your diagram source is rendered locally.
command.clearCache.title: Clear Render Cache and Re-render
command.exportSvg.title: Export Diagram as SVG
command.exportAllSvg.title: Export All Diagrams as SVG
command.exportAllAndUpdateRefs.title: Export All Diagrams and Update References
config.theme.description: Diagram colour palette. "auto" follows the VS Code colour theme.
config.logLevel.description: Log level for the PlantUML Local output channel. The Output panel's own level selector applies on top of this.
config.exportDirectory.description: Where exported SVGs are written, relative to the Markdown file. Use "." for the same folder. Absolute paths and ".." are rejected.
config.exportTheme.description: Palette for exported SVGs. Exports face hosts like GitHub whose background this extension does not control, so "light" is the default; "preview" follows the palette the preview currently uses.
config.hideExportedImages.description: Hide images marked with #plantuml-local in the Markdown preview, so an exported diagram is not shown next to its block's own render. Turn off to check how the exported SVG itself looks.
